text:
Forty lifts on a fifth of one battery.

The winch is a twelve volt one, bolted to the first tree and run off a battery. Its line runs up the trunk to a block at the tie, along under the rope to a pulley at the crossing, and down to a hook. The heaviest triangle, 66 kilograms, pulls 0.65 kilonewtons against a winch rated 6.7: 10 times over. Lifting it 6.1 metres costs about 3 watt hours, so all forty take 126, about 21 percent of what one hundred amp hour battery should give.
